mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SMS_SEND_QUEUE ( DEST_PHONE, SEND_PHONE, MSG_BODY, MSG_TYPE, REQ_TX_SEQ, SEND_STATUS, EXT_RESULT_CODE, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{destPhone}, #{sendPhone}, #{msgBody}, #{msgType}, #{reqTxSeq}, #{sendStatus}, #{extResultCode}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SMS_SEND_QUEUE SET SEND_STATUS = #{sendStatus}, EXT_RESULT_CODE = #{extResultCode}, SENT_DT = NOW() WHERE SMS_SEQ = #{smsSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT SMS_SEQ, DEST_PHONE, SEND_PHONE, MSG_BODY, MSG_TYPE, REQ_TX_SEQ, SEND_STATUS, EXT_RESULT_CODE, REG_DT, SENT_DT FROM TB_SMS_SEND_QUEUE WHERE REQ_TX_SEQ = #{reqTxSeq} ORDER BY SMS_SEQ DESC
